title: Laboratoire O92 — audit du corpus, essais comparatifs et formalisation de conception
red_rules_operationalization: Aucune conclusion préalable sur la capacité ou l’incapacité ultime d’AAM; seuls les résultats limités d’un protocole donné sont rapportés.
PASS, FAIL_QUALITY_GATE, NOT_RUN, INVALID_INPUT, ENVIRONMENT_ERROR et INCONCLUSIVE restent des statuts distincts.
Les ensembles IID de validation choisissent les variantes; les HOLDOUT/OOD sont gelés et ne servent pas au choix du modèle.
Les copies exactes sont liées par SHA-256, mais leurs occurrences et chemins restent présents dans le carnet.
Toute promotion de compétence exige une inférence sans oracle/source, un contrat explicite, un test indépendant et un état réversible.
Limites de budget/plateforme sont documentées comme telles et ne sont jamais réécrites comme impossibilités mathématiques.

environment.no_implementation_claim: O92 n’a pas été implémenté, conformément au périmètre demandé.

methodology.coverage: Per-path records cover all unpacked root occurrences plus every file inside each distinct recursively extracted nested archive content. Byte-identical files are parsed once per hash and each occurrence links to the shared result.
methodology.text_and_code: Text is fully read; structure, headings, keyword evidence and format-specific parse/schema/count checks are produced. Python AST is inspected where syntax permits. Key theory/formalism/model/report claims receive explicit synthesis reviews.
methodology.binary: Binary assets get hash, exact size, signature and available metadata. Arbitrary pickle/torch weights are not deserialized. Parquet is signature-checked but not semantically decoded.
methodology.reasoning_note: These are source-grounded audit notes, candidate mechanisms and risk flags, not private step-by-step internal reasoning.
methodology.limits: Automated parsing of every textual file is not the same as a human interpretation of every possible semantic implication in all binary data; any undecoded or unexecuted item remains explicitly open.

archive_audit.precision_note: Les fichiers textuels et scripts sont structurés/analysés par contenu unique; chaque occurrence de chemin est enregistrée. Les checkpoints binaires ne sont ni désérialisés ni prétendus compris sémantiquement. 0000.parquet n’a pas été décodé faute de moteur adapté.

source_synthesis.finding: Fingerprint is a tuple of typed probe responses. Its equivalence classes/fibers depend on declared probe family; a new coordinate only refines the partition when it separates prior collisions.
source_synthesis.O92_decision: Versioned typed probe signatures with schema, calibration, references, uncertainty and data provenance; separate observation/representation/prediction/action/certification.
source_synthesis.caveat: A finite signature is not complete semantics absent a stated domain and separating-probe argument.

source_synthesis.finding: Mirror means a relation to a declared reference, not a special semantic primitive. The corpus formalizes ordering: reuse existing probes, compose them, try relational/mirror probes, then introduce a new primitive only to resolve an evidenced collision.
source_synthesis.O92_decision: Probe search records partition refinement, expected value, cost, invariants and side effects.
source_synthesis.caveat: Result depends on reference choice, typed relation and normalization.

source_synthesis.source: DDD base theory and observation formalisms
source_synthesis.finding: Observing an observer, stored representation or previous observation may reveal a relation; it does not guarantee new information or behavior.
source_synthesis.O92_decision: Meta-loop must produce a falsifiable hypothesis, probe, prediction, observation, update and ablation; reward alone cannot certify progress.
source_synthesis.caveat: Self-description, recursion and score gain do not establish strong meaning/intelligence.

source_synthesis.source: DDD base theory, O91 skills/certification code
source_synthesis.finding: Hash/AST similarity/program signature cannot alone establish acquisition. Competence requires independent behavioral tests and clear support/domain.
source_synthesis.O92_decision: Statuses candidate -> executed -> held-out passed -> source-disconnected -> independent-certified -> deployed; capsule provenance and rollback retained.
source_synthesis.caveat: Each certificate is only for declared tasks/domain and test protocol.

source_synthesis.finding: O91 provides 178/178 audit suite tests in this environment, offline installation report, bounded text skills, CAS tests, controlled OCR/image and signal tests. Tested PocketSphinx ASR gate failed on 10 synthetic English samples; native Windows acceptance and real-weight semantic VLM/global neural foundation training were not run per report.
source_synthesis.O92_decision: Retain local-first modular runtime, trace ledgers, capsule verification and abstention; label integration plumbing separately from real model weights/capability.
source_synthesis.caveat: Only exact executed environment and commands are evidenced.

source_synthesis.source: formalismes/, rapports/, nested O65–O91 and ORDER 8 archives
source_synthesis.finding: The corpus contains many versions, corrected builds and copied audit artifacts; version numbers do not rank general intelligence, and duplicate reports are not independent replications.
source_synthesis.O92_decision: Content-addressed manifest and per-trial code/config/data/split/command hashes; compare mechanisms and tests by capability.
source_synthesis.caveat: Deduplicate by hash for analysis only; retain every file path/occurrence in the manifest.

source_synthesis.source: O91 media modules plus O92 controlled synthetic image ablation
source_synthesis.finding: Global/quadrant/mirror/inverse views add information only when normalized/fused appropriately. On controlled shapes, generic geometry fingerprint reached balanced accuracy 1.0 on IID, shifted position/scale and inverse-palette sets; naive concatenation of all raw views also reached 1.0 IID/shifted but only 0.5 inverse palette despite 2208 dimensions.
source_synthesis.O92_decision: Contrast/polarity canonicalization, shared/per-view weights, view-level reliability gates, consensus/disagreement and robust abstention; raw views remain optional evidence.
source_synthesis.caveat: Synthetic single centered contrast object, one seed and one linear classifier; not evidence for natural image/video/audio semantics.

source_synthesis.finding: Temporal single-target task: validation selected fingerprint-weight MLP (F1 .9873) by fixed rule; on frozen 2009-through-2010-01-01 test it reached F1 .9727, while per-view ensemble reached .9834 and threshold+raw fingerprint model .9780. Shows selection uncertainty, with large lift over majority baseline.
source_synthesis.O92_decision: Keep separate typed views/heads and test-only freeze, calibration and target-proxy/leak audit; optimize multiple independent tasks.
source_synthesis.caveat: One target and seven Basel weather fields; high predictability can reflect label definition, not intelligence or causality.

source_synthesis.finding: Four synthetic numeric teachers provided only frozen examples/ground truth; polynomial fingerprint neurons learned affine, quadratic and cubic exactly, while compact MLP won validation for hinge-like piecewise function. Prediction functions had no teacher call at inference.
source_synthesis.O92_decision: Export source-disconnected skill capsules; evaluate exact/holdout/OOD and choose on validation only.
source_synthesis.caveat: Four low-dimensional functions and single seed; cannot imply arbitrary adapter/program acquisition.

source_synthesis.finding: Screenplay JSONL 4,000 valid; batch JSONL 783 valid and one malformed line. Weather and label CSV each 3,654 rows with unique matching DATE; selected Basel inputs have no missing values. Parquet signature captured but schema/content not decoded.
source_synthesis.O92_decision: Transactional loaders preserve rejected rows and rationale, split manifests and input hashes.
source_synthesis.caveat: No semantic claims about Parquet rows in this audit.

source_synthesis.source: O91 docs/windows_validation.md, UI source and status reports
source_synthesis.finding: O91 documents Linux/Xvfb UI evidence and planned PowerShell checks; that is not native Windows acceptance.
source_synthesis.O92_decision: Windows desktop (PySide6 primary, Tk fallback), local service, chat/RAG/dataset loader, skill catalogue, experiment monitor and offline operation; native Windows has its own acceptance gate.
source_synthesis.caveat: No native Windows execution evidence in this Linux session.

architecture_decisions_from_source.decision: Neurons are learned weights over structured fingerprints, not mere memories.
architecture_decisions_from_source.design: Fingerprint Neuron (FPN): typed per-view encoder, raw/derived probe coordinates, learnable sparse/dense weights, uncertainty, reliability, task-conditioned output, evidence reference. Exemplar/prototype/RAG is a separate channel.

architecture_decisions_from_source.decision: Existing probe closure before new primitive.
architecture_decisions_from_source.design: Planner searches reuse, parallel/sequential composition, relational/mirror against explicit reference, then new probes only if a documented collision remains and expected discrimination exceeds cost.

architecture_decisions_from_source.decision: Image/audio/video multiview is normalized and audited.
architecture_decisions_from_source.design: Whole observation, four quadrants/regions, mirrored views and contrast/polarity-normalized inverse; retain each signature separately, share/tie weights for symmetry, reliability-gated fusion, time windows for audio/video, preserve disagreement and abstain if critical view unavailable.

architecture_decisions_from_source.decision: Meta-observation is a measured closed loop.
architecture_decisions_from_source.design: Observe state/weights/observer -> create hypothesis -> predict probe output -> execute under budget -> compare -> update policy/weights/uncertainty -> test on held-out behavior -> promote or roll back.

architecture_decisions_from_source.decision: Black-box skill acquisition has source-off acceptance.
architecture_decisions_from_source.design: Collect examples -> infer candidate contract/invariants -> fit FPN/rule/MLP -> package standalone state and versioned feature schema -> disable oracle/adapter -> exact/heldout/OOD/safety tests -> independent verifier -> append-only skill library and rollback.

architecture_decisions_from_source.decision: Autonomy is an obligation of design, not a verdict.
architecture_decisions_from_source.design: Persistent scheduler, self-originated goal queue from declared objectives/curiosity/reward, plan/decomposition, tool and local resource discovery, memory/RAG, experiments, execution, verification, reflection and policy updates. High-impact external actions and security boundary crossings follow explicit permission policy; missing dependency is surfaced honestly.

architecture_decisions_from_source.decision: No hard-coded ceiling or prediction about ultimate success.
architecture_decisions_from_source.design: Capability hypotheses are tested by named protocols; status labels distinguish NOT_RUN/INCONCLUSIVE/FAIL/PASS. Self-improvement remains iterative and open-ended, bounded only by transparent compute, safety and provenance controls rather than arbitrary architecture caps.
